title: Duckling wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#FFD84D'/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='20' ry='12' fill='#F5C42E'/>
  <!-- wing -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='70' rx='9' ry='13' fill='#F7C93E' transform='rotate(-15 72 70)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='22' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <!-- head shading -->
  <path d='M28 38 A22 22 0 0 0 72 38 A22 22 0 0 1 28 38' fill='#F5CE3A' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- duckling fluff on head -->
  <path d='M44 17 Q47 9 51 16 Q54 8 57 16 Q58 22 50 21 Q46 21 44 17' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <!-- sunglasses lens left -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='38' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#2B2B3A'/>
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='38' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#4A6BD6' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- lens shine left -->
  <rect x='35' y='33' width='4' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#A8C4FF'/>
  <!-- sunglasses lens right -->
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='38' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#2B2B3A'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='38' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#4A6BD6' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- lens shine right -->
  <rect x='53' y='33' width='4' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#A8C4FF'/>
  <!-- frame -->
  <rect x='32' y='34.5' width='18' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#1F1F2E'/>
  <rect x='50' y='34.5' width='18' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#1F1F2E'/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x='48' y='36' width='4' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#1F1F2E'/>
  <!-- temple arms -->
  <rect x='25' y='36' width='7' height='2' rx='1' fill='#1F1F2E'/>
  <rect x='68' y='36' width='7' height='2' rx='1' fill='#1F1F2E'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M42 47 Q50 55 58 47 Q50 51 42 47' fill='#FF9A2E'/>
  <path d='M44 48 Q50 53 56 48' stroke='#E07F1A' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <path d='M38 88 L34 94 L42 92 L45 95 L46 89 Z' fill='#FF9A2E'/>
  <path d='M62 88 L66 94 L58 92 L55 95 L54 89 Z' fill='#FF9A2E'/>
</svg>
